name: contains_water
query: LOOKUP ON passage WHERE passage.text CONTAINS "water" YIELD id(vertex) AS vid, passage.text AS text | LIMIT 10;

name: contains_new_york
query: LOOKUP ON passage WHERE passage.text CONTAINS "New York" YIELD id(vertex) AS vid, passage.text AS text | LIMIT 10;

name: starts_with_the
query: LOOKUP ON passage WHERE passage.text STARTS WITH "The" YIELD id(vertex) AS vid, passage.text AS text | LIMIT 10;

name: ends_with_period
query: LOOKUP ON passage WHERE passage.text ENDS WITH "." YIELD id(vertex) AS vid, passage.text AS text | LIMIT 10;
